description.value: Kissing Crows Cyclery is a full-service bicycle shop on Main Street in Vancouver, operating on the unceded territories of the Musqueam, Squamish, and Tsleil-Waututh Nations. The shop offers professional one-on-one bike fitting alongside sales and mechanical services bookable online. It also runs regular community group rides of varying distances and terrain types, making it a social anchor for local and visiting cyclists alike.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: OSM tags identify this as a bicycle shop (shop=bicycle) at 4562 Main Street, Vancouver, corroborated by the website which confirms the same address and primary phone number (604) 872-5477. The website's SERVICE BOOKING navigation item and the contact page reference to 'SERVICE OFFERINGS' confirm mechanical work is offered; the GROUP RIDES page documents shop-organized rides with stated routes, pacing, and start point at the shop. One concern: the contact page lists a slightly different phone number (604 872 5447) versus (604) 872-5477 on all other pages — likely a transposition typo.
concerns: Phone number discrepancy on the /contact subpage: 'FOR TIME SENSITIVE REQUESTS, PLEASE CALL US AT 604 872 5447' differs from (604) 872-5477 listed on all other pages and in OSM — likely a transposition typo but worth verifying.
